overview_description.description:
At  Love That Design, we provide resources to design and build your ideal space.

We help the design and construction industry win and deliver more work by showcasing their expertise on projects executed and enabling all the stakeholders in the value chain. By this, we are creating the largest design and construction community for customers globally. We do this through two offerings

1) Love That Design: Design platform connecting the interior design industry offering online and in-person engagement.

2) .STUDIO:  Workflow automation software that manages & tracks project resources from Pitch to Completion.

Unlike product aggregators and traditional SaaS providers, we offer a unique combination of industry engagement, data, and tools to create a self-managed and self-growing ecosystem.
